Class ServicePoint

java.lang.Object
simu.model.ServicePoint
public class ServicePoint extends Object
Represents a service point in the hospital patient flow simulation. Manages patients waiting in a queue, handles patient priorities, controls service capacity, and schedules service completion events. Also collects statistics such as waiting times, queue lengths, and service utilization.

  • Constructor Details

    • ServicePoint

      public ServicePoint(ContinuousGenerator generator, EventList tapahtumalista, EventType tyyppi, String name, int capacity, Controller controller)
      Creates a service point for the hospital simulation.
      Parameters:
      generator - generates the service time for each patient
      tapahtumalista - event list used to schedule service completion
      tyyppi - type of event scheduled when service is completed
      name - name of the service point
      capacity - maximum number of patients served simultaneously
      controller - controller used to update patient waiting status

  • Method Details

    • addQueue

      public void addQueue(Customer customer)
      Adds a patient to the waiting queue. Priority patients are placed before normal patients. Patients with the same priority are served in FIFO (First In, First Out) order. Records the patient's queue entry time and updates the maximum queue length.
      Parameters:
      customer - the patient to add to the waiting queue

    • removeQueue

      public Customer removeQueue()
      Removes and returns the patient whose service has finished. The patient with the earliest scheduled completion time is removed from the list of patients being served. One service position becomes available.
      Returns:
      the patient whose service has completed, or null if no patient is currently being served

    • beginService

      public void beginService()
      Starts service for waiting patients when capacity is available. Removes patients from the waiting queue in priority order and records their waiting times. Generates a service duration for each patient and calculates the scheduled completion time. Updates service statistics and schedules a completion event in the simulation event list.

    • isReserved

      public boolean isReserved()
      Checks whether the service point is operating at full capacity.
      Returns:
      true if all service positions are occupied, false if at least one position is available

    • getAverageWaitingTime

      public double getAverageWaitingTime()
      Calculates the average waiting time of patients who have started service. Divides the total waiting time by the number of patients who have started service. Returns zero if no patient has started service.
      Returns:
      the average patient waiting time in simulation minutes

    • getMaximumQueueLength

      public int getMaximumQueueLength()

    • getTotalServiceTime

      public double getTotalServiceTime()

      Returns:
      the total generated service time in simulation minutes

    • getUtilization

      public double getUtilization()
      Calculates the utilization percentage of this service point using the current simulation clock time. Utilization is calculated by dividing the total generated service time by the available service capacity over time.
      Returns:
      the service point utilization percentage

    • getCustomersStartedService

      public int getCustomersStartedService()
      Returns the total number of patients who have started receiving service at this service point.
      Returns:
      the number of patients who have started service

    • getQueueLength

      public int getQueueLength()
      Returns the current number of patients waiting in the service point queue.
      Returns:
      the current queue length

    • getUtilization

      public double getUtilization(double simulationTime)
      Calculates the utilization percentage of this service point using the specified simulation time. Utilization is calculated from the total generated service time, simulation duration, and service capacity.
      Parameters:
      simulationTime - the simulation duration in minutes
      Returns:
      the calculated utilization percentage, or zero if simulation time is zero or negative
